posts.title: Mohamudgarah (Bhaja Govindam)
posts.subtitle: Bhaja Govindam. The phrase translates literally to ‘Revere Govinda,’ an epithet of Krishna. Yet the word Govinda carries far greater depth than this simple rendering suggests.
